item.title: Peachey's opens second Sarasota County donut store

item.title: $12B Tampa mining company promotes leader to VP role
item.description: Chris Hagemo, a 23-year leader at The Mosaic Co., a $12 billion Tampa-based global fertilizer producer, has been promoted to vice president of global operations, strategy and operational excellence.Hagemo began his career as a USF engineering co-op student, the company says. item.description: A Southwest Florida luxury real estate firm has acquired a Punta Gorda brokerage. John R.
